paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Abaye came before Rav Ḥisda, Ḥullin 95b. Perhaps it should read bar Abba. See below, R. Natan bar Avin, whom Yuḥasin calls Rav Ḥisda's student; perhaps it is this figure.
